name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Time refinement/phase, synchronized all-step energy,P/L/COM,independent pair force and root residuals. An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects.

name.ja: 無軟化Kepler二体の時間誤差

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 解析解 G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4、epsilon0、128/256/512steps、初期COM/P0。 位相/時間次数、全同期stepエネルギー、P/L/COM、独立pair力とroot残差。 1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。 1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Analytic reference G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4,epsilon0,128/256/512steps,initialCOM/P0. One orbit at fixed eccentricity only; softened binaries and long-time behavior are outside this exact reference.

name.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 半解析解 a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Semi-analytic reference a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint. Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.

name.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓

note.ja: 2自由度の実結合系で、12の64刻みprobeと6の精度軌道を使い、真のモード、座標間交換、離散写像と丸めを分けます。
note.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.

name.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

note.ja: 単振り子の10固定軌道で、位置拘束、全時刻の接線運動量と内部点の中心化運動量を区別します。
note.en: Ten fixed pendulum evolutions distinguish position constraints, full-time tangent momentum and interior centered momentum.

note.ja: e=0.1/0.7の16固定軌道で、保存量と同時刻の位相誤差、実際の近日点時刻と逆積分を比較します。
note.en: Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal.
